query: What category of expenses are non-subsidised bills pro-rated for under the Medishield program?
reference_answer: Non-subsidised bills are pro-rated for outpatient cancer treatments and home parenteral nutrition.
context:
[Document 1]
Non-subsidised bills are pro-rated for outpatient cancer treatments and home parenteral nutrition.

[Document 2]
Older Pioneer Generation seniors with serious pre-existing conditions receive additional MediSave top-ups of $50 to $200 annually from 2021 to 2025, which can be used to pay MediShield Life premiums.

[Document 3]
The deductible under MediShield Life ranges from $2,000 to $4,500, depending on the claimant's age and choice of ward class.

[Document 4]
The claimable amount is $1,000 and it is less than the deductible of $2,000, so there is no payout from MediShield Life.

[Document 5]
Residents living in residences with an Annual Value above $31,000 are not eligible to receive subsidies under the Medishield program.
answer: Non-subsidised bills are pro-rated for outpatient cancer treatments and home parenteral nutrition under the Medishield program. [Document 1]
